title: AET-B opens: #220 is dispositioned as PARKED (owned, deferred) and the AET-B gate of docs/14 section 8 is met
decided_at_provenance: RECORDED AT DECISION TIME in the Claude Code session where it was made. The operator said 'Start Engineer Team'. options_considered.A: Park #220 with an owner and open AET-B -- SELECTED. #220 is a demand-learning bookkeeping defect (finished demands sit AUTHORIZED, so the learning guard is unreachable). It is independent of the runtime substrate. A recorded disposition is what docs/14 section 8 asks for.
options_considered.B: Fix #220 first, then open AET-B -- NOT SELECTED: slower; gates the runtime on an unrelated bookkeeping fix.
options_considered.C: Remove #220 from AET-B's prerequisites by amending docs/14 section 8 -- NOT SELECTED: edits doctrine to clear a gate the doctrine already lets a disposition clear.

authorizes.summary: #220 is PARKED: owned by the human_sponsor and deferred to a future work package. AET-B opens with S1 (enforcement-surface routing) in WP-2026-0157. Later AET-B components (S2-S5) are separate work packages.
